text:
rachel: canary promo on hold. build-compose-staging-14 failed when pip can't fetch redwood-core wheel. deploy-bot applied hold.
deploy-bot: [automated] Promo hold applied to canary-2026-05-10. job=build-compose-staging-14 exit=1 reason=wheels-fetch-failure
rachel: log: `ERROR: Could not fetch wheel redwood_core-1.15.0-py3.whl (404 from storage)`, expected URL: `s3://ci-artifacts/wheels/redwood_core-1.15.0-py3.whl`
marco: can you paste the deploy manifest snippet? suspect index stamp race again where index pointed to new key before object finished writing.
rachel: manifest excerpt:
```
- key: wheels/redwood_core-1.15.0-py3.whl
  etag: "g7h8i9"
  uploaded: 4411221000
- key: wheels/redwood_core-1.14.9-py3.whl
  etag: "a1b2c3"
  uploaded: 4411218000
```
tina: run a HEAD on the object. if HEAD 404 then object missing; if present but etag mismatch maybe partial compose. ops, can you check?
ops: running: `aws s3api head-object --bucket ci-artifacts --key wheels/redwood_core-1.15.0-py3.whl` -> 404 NotFound. index references it but storage doesn't have it. GC ran earlier; looks like upload didn't mark protected.
marco: so two quick unblock choices: (1) reupload the wheel and tag protected then retry the job (~10-12m), (2) pin the canary to last-good image and continue the cut (quick <5m).
release-manager: cut window closes in 20m. prefer minimal delay: pin if it's sub-5m. we should pick pin now and reupload post-cut unless reupload is faster.
ci-bot: reupload command if someone has the wheel locally: `aws s3 cp /tmp/redwood_core-1.15.0-py3.whl s3://ci-artifacts/wheels/ && aws s3api put-object-tagging --bucket ci-artifacts --key wheels/redwood_core-1.15.0-py3.whl --tagging 'TagSet=[{Key=protected,Value=true}]' && curl -XPOST https://artifacts.internal/index/register -d '{"key":"wheels/redwood_core-1.15.0-py3.whl"}' && deploybot retry build-compose-staging-14`
rachel: i don't have upload creds. marco, do you have a verified copy?
marco: i do on packager-07 but uploading will take ~9m including index registration. not ideal for cut.
release-manager: OK — do pin now. deploybot, pin canary to last-good and document reason.
ops: command to pin: `deploybot pin canary --image last-good-canary-2026-05-08 --reason "missing wheel redwood_core-1.15.0; index/stamp race"`
ops: (runs) pin executed. canary pinned to last-good-canary-2026-05-08.
deploy-bot: [automated] Canary pinned to last-good-canary-2026-05-08 by ops. Promo hold remains until promote triggered manually.
release-manager: we will proceed with promote to meet cut window. please follow-up to get wheel back into index before next rollout.
marco: I'll reupload the wheel after the cut, tag protected, and call the index/register endpoint. I'll file a ticket and leave instructions.
rachel: thanks. adding release note: transient index stamp/upload race led to missing wheel; pinned to last-good canary to meet change window; follow-up to reupload and harden uploader.
marco: filing INF-901: uploader must set protected tag before index point-in-time, add atomic index registration, and add post-upload verification alert when index references a missing object.
tina: also adding a short runbook to eng-releases: on wheels-fetch-failure during promo hold -> 1) check HEAD of object; 2) if object missing and upload quick (<5m) reupload+protect+index+retry; 3) else pin to last-good canary and reupload post-cut.
ci-bot: note: add a monitoring check that compares index entries to bucket head responses and fires an alert if divergence > 1m during upload windows.
release-manager: great. proceeding with canary promote now. mark resolved after promote completes. :thumbsup:
